title: The Stereotype Mirror
learning_focus: Age/gender/socio-economic stereotypes, real vs make-believe, fact vs non-fact images, cultural appropriateness, and inference.
story_premise: A mirror gallery changes people into simplistic images based on labels. The Pathfinder must restore individual stories and evidence.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Age/gender/socio-economic stereotypes, real vs make-believe, fact vs non-fact images, cultural appropriateness, and inference.

areas.title: Label Hall
areas.story: Identify stereotypes and unsupported assumptions. Distinguish staged, fictional, edited, and documentary images.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Mission Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The Haze has damaged the work in Label Hall.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Mission Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the clues, use Age/gender/socio-economic stereotypes, real vs make-believe, fact vs non-fact images, cultural appropriateness, and inference, and repair this area before collecting the Story Fragment.

learning_clues: Learning focus: Age/gender/socio-economic stereotypes, real vs make-believe, fact vs non-fact images, cultural appropriateness, and inference.
